$comment: B1.5c genre alias table. Catalog-derived only: every alias target is one of the 56 values of filter_movies.genres[].items.enum (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM genres ORDER BY name). No external data source, no hand-written long-tail mapping. Asserted by scripts/eval/check_schema.py.
source: fabflix-mysql:3307/moviedb genres table (56 distinct names) + the B1.5b GENRE_ALIASES vocabulary that this file replaces; the additions Fantasy/History/Sport/War and the Musical/Music split are plan §5.1/B15c-5 decisions

semantics.aliases: user term (Chinese or English, compared casefolded) -> canonical keys. A canonical key is always one of the 56 enum values.
semantics.canonical_groups: values that denote the same genre. The first member is the canonical key; the others are variants. Row retrieval may use IN (<all members>) but a multi-value AND filter counts one match per canonical key, never one per variant (docs/plans/b1-5c-tool-routing-fixes.md §5.1).
semantics.unsupported: enum values with no alias. They stay in the enum (they are real catalog values) but must never receive a hand-written alias and must never appear in a canonical group; mapping them would silently route users into long-tail/porn rows (scout §1.1/§4.1).

notes: B1.5b reported 43 word forms / 17 alias targets and left 39 enum values unmapped. B1.5c adds Fantasy, History, Sport and War (the four genres the frozen 75 never exercised; 492/215/103/125 rows), splits Musical (139 rows) from Music (619 rows) and makes Science Fiction a variant of Sci-Fi, so 39 = 5 promoted to targets + 1 promoted to a canonical variant + the 33 names below.
unsupported is asserted to equal (56 enum values - alias targets - canonical group variants): check_schema.py recomputes it, so an enum change or a new alias cannot leave this list stale.
Alias targets must never be an unsupported name and must never appear in canonical_groups' variant positions; both are asserted.

Chinese director/genre words that are transliterations (e.g. 希区柯克) are deliberately absent: person normalization is catalog-derived only (person-normalization.json) and genre aliases must not invent names.
